change_summary: System-level state management FC architecture pattern (BswSys_Gp family).
family_pattern: BswSys_Gp (system-level module, no external chip, no hardware registers)

key_characteristics.mainfunction_reason: System-status oriented with query-style APIs. No periodic hardware polling needed.
key_characteristics.calibration_note: BswSys_Gp may have Cali.c when calibration workflow is project-defined
key_characteristics.api_style: System-status query APIs; asynchronous behavior described in header comments even for getters
key_characteristics.config_style: Signal-count macros, signal-ID mapping macros, revise-switch macros, DET switch
key_characteristics.dependency_style: Revise hooks (CalloutXxxDataRevise) rather than hardware access callouts
key_characteristics.internal_headers: May include FC_Internal.h for internal state sharing within BswSys_Gp layer

external_apis.name: Gp_SysState_Init
external_apis.description: Initializes system state module, sets default state.

external_apis.name: Gp_SysState_GetCurrentState
external_apis.description: Returns current system state. May be asynchronous if state is updated by external triggers.

dependency_apis.name: Gp_SysState_CalloutStateDataRevise
dependency_apis.description: Revise hook for state data before consumption. Project adaptation point.

config_macros.name: GP_SYSSTATE_CFG_STATE_ID_<NAME>
config_macros.purpose: Signal ID mapping macros for state identifiers.

calibration_items.name: Gp_SysState_StateThresholds
calibration_items.description: Calibration thresholds for state transitions (conditional — only when project calibration workflow exists).

runtime_states.name: CurrentState
runtime_states.read_write_side: Written by external state updates; read by GetCurrentState.
runtime_states.lifecycle: Set to DEFAULT at Init; updated by triggers/events.
runtime_states.concurrency_strategy: Global (system state is inherently global, not per-core).

runtime_states.name: StateRecorder buffer
runtime_states.read_write_side: Written on state transitions; read by diagnostic APIs.

memmap_sections.name: RUNTIME RAM (NO_CLEAR)
memmap_sections.target_content: State recorder buffer (retained across warm reset).

file_items.name: Gp_SysState_Internal.h
file_items.note: BswSys_Gp pattern: Internal.h for layer-internal state sharing
